labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory: CVE-2026-4539 concerns Pygments, not Rich code

body:
This advisory (CVE-2026-4539) concerns Pygments, the dependency Rich uses for syntax highlighting, not code in Rich itself. Rich cannot fix the advisory directly; the Pygments project is the right place to follow it.

For vulnerability reports, please use the private process in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md rather than a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
